core.before: ASK contains one explicit question on one decision axis, with relevant explained choices and applicable notices.
core.after: ASK contains one explicit question on one decision axis, with applicable notices. Use explained choices when they help the user understand or make that decision; a direct factual or open-field question does not require a menu.

core.before: Label options A, B, C, and so on. EVERY substantive option needs a brief meaning, consequence or trade-off, not a bare name/acronym.
core.after: When presenting options, label them A, B, C, and so on. EVERY substantive option needs a brief meaning, consequence or trade-off, not a bare name/acronym.

core.before: Normally offer 2-5 genuine choices; never pad, bundle distinct amendment paths under one label, or omit important alternatives to meet that style limit.
core.after: When using a menu, normally offer 2-5 genuine choices; never pad, bundle distinct amendment paths under one label, or omit important alternatives to meet that style limit.

core.before: For factual clarification, offer direct confirmation of relevant possible states with brief implications and an unknown/verify route, not merely evidence-supply methods or hypothetical output; ask what is established, never which truth is preferred or recommended.
core.after: For factual clarification, ask what is established, never which truth is preferred or recommended. Ask directly for a necessary fact or value when that is clearer; present relevant possible states with brief implications and an unknown/verify route when those states help the user answer.

core.before: Open fields need honest explained ways to specify values, no invented facts/dates.
core.after: Open fields may request the actual value directly; explain ways to specify it only when helpful, without inventing facts or dates.

metadata.before: Ask one contextual question with explained options before answering when material context is missing.
metadata.after: Ask one contextual question when material context is missing; use explained options when useful.

metadata.before: It asks one relevant question with explained options at a time, then answers after material choices are settled.
metadata.after: It asks one relevant question at a time, with explained options when useful, then answers after material choices are settled.
